newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes lower, volume up.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes lower, volume up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed lower by 0.05 percent in higher trade boosted by over-the-counter exchanges, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 546.04 from 546.31 on Monday.
Volume was 11 million dinars against 6.3 million dinars. Over-the-counter turnover was 10.23 million dinars.
Chemical firm reversed its downward trend and was up 0.82 dinar to 28.32 dinars. Banque du Sud won 0.75 dinar to 25.32 dinars. UBCI bank declined by 0.76 dinar to 45.2. ($1=one dinar)
